title: IR-Playbook-DNS-Tunneling
summary: Mitigation and response procedures for anomalous DNS queries, base64 encoded TXT/NULL record exfiltration, and DNS command-and-control channels.
content:
1. Containment of DNS Exfiltration Channels

1.1 Sinkhole Malicious Domains: Update edge recursive DNS servers (e.g. Infoblox, BIND) to sinkhole the identified apex domain and all subdomains to 127.0.0.1 or an internal honeynet responder.

1.2 Restrict Outbound UDP/TCP 53: Enforce firewall egress rules permitting port 53 traffic strictly from approved internal DNS forwarders. Block direct client-to-external DNS communications to neutralize rogue resolvers.

2. Investigation & Identification of Impacted Hosts

2.1 Query High-Entropy Domain Logs: Filter internal DNS resolver query logs for domains with high Shannon entropy, unusually long subdomains (>50 characters), and high volumes of TXT or NULL record queries.

2.2 Identify Patient Zero Client IP: Map internal IP addresses generating abnormal DNS request bursts to specific hostnames and logged-in user sessions.

3. Remediation & Hardening

3.1 Flush Resolver Caches: Flush DNS caches across all enterprise resolvers to purge poisoned or cached malicious resolution paths.

3.2 Implement Response Policy Zones (RPZ): Subscribe enterprise resolvers to automated threat intelligence feeds for newly registered domains (NRDs).

steps.title: Sinkhole malicious domain and block outbound client port 53
steps.description: Add the attacker's apex domain to the enterprise DNS sinkhole list and verify edge firewalls block non-internal DNS servers on port 53 UDP/TCP.

steps.title: Analyze passive DNS logs for high-entropy TXT records
steps.description: Inspect query volume and payload length in resolver logs to identify client machines issuing excessive TXT or NULL record requests encoding exfiltrated data.

steps.title: Flush enterprise DNS cache and enforce Response Policy Zones
steps.description: Flush all caching resolvers to invalidate adversary domain records and update RPZ blacklists to block newly registered tunneling subdomains.
